chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id, who reported from Ja'far ibn Abdillah, who reported from his brother Muhammad ibn Abdillah, who reported from Ishaq ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Hilal al-Mazhaji, who said: Your father Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq, peace be upon them both, told me:

"When you are in need, rise early in the day, for the provisions are distributed before sunrise. And Allah, Most High, has blessed this nation in its early hours. And give away alms in the early hour, because adversities do not pass over the alms."

key_terms.البكور: Early morning; the habit of rising at dawn

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about rising early and giving alms?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) advises that when one has a need, one should rise early to attend to it, since provisions are distributed before sunrise and Allah has blessed this nation in its early hours. He also encourages giving alms in the early morning, as adversity does not surpass charity.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 16. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from Abul Abbas ibnMuhammad ibn Saeed, who reported from Ja’far ibn Abdillah, who reported from his brother Muhammad ibn Abdillah, who reported from Ishaq ibn Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Hilal al-Mazhaji, who said: Your father Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq (as) told me: "

When you are in (financial) need, rise early in the day, for the subsistence (Rizq) is distributed before sunrise. And Allah, Most High, has blessed this Ummah in its early hours; and give away alms in the early hour; because adversities do not follow the alms (Sadaqah)."
